subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the sentence given below.

I __refuse __to let anything come in the way of my dreams.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **permit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"refuse"** means to indicate or show that one is not willing to do something. (इनकार करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She refused to accept the job offer due to the long commute.
 
 
 
• **"Permit"** refers to allowing something to happen or giving permission for it. (अनुमति देना)
 
 
• **Example: **The city council decided to permit the event in the central park.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'refuse'** is **'permit'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **permit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Repress** (दबाना): To subdue someone or something by force.

 
 
• **Example:** The government tried to repress the uprising with a heavy hand.
 
 
 
• **Balk** (रोकना): To hesitate or be unwilling to accept an idea or undertaking.
 
 
• **Example: **She balked at the high price of the concert tickets.
 
 
 
• **Accord** (सहमति): To give or grant someone power, status, or recognition.
 
 
• **Example:** The Nobel Prize was accorded to her for her contribution to science.
